answers.label: Feedback on stated purposes of the MBM
answers.text: We have a few concerns. There is currently no mechanism and tool in place, and no renewable energy market capable of supporting hourly matching at scale. We believe It's not feasible to do hourly matching for most companies in near term. Considering this is a global well-established standard, we strongly recommend having hourly matching as optional choice instead of requirement. We also recommend allowing more transition time to implement hourly matching, increase the hourly matching exemption threshold, increase the flexibility/wider deliverability market boundary for hourly matching.
